title: Double Cross component diagram
description: Double Cross: a Godot client that plays the whole match in each browser, with the host's browser deciding what happens, and a small Worker that serves the build to signed-in players.

components.name: Double Cross
components.responsibility: One game: the Godot client and its Worker, built and deployed together.

components.name: Godot client
components.responsibility: Menus, the briefing room, the match (world, agents, traps, HUD, spectator grid) and the message layer that carries it between browsers.

components.name: Page boot script
components.responsibility: Starts the Godot engine behind the loading screen.

components.name: Game Worker
components.responsibility: Serves the build: the signed-in page, the engine joined from its parts, and the static files.

components.name: Games hub
components.responsibility: The games hub at icelander.net/games (the recreations repository's Worker): the multiplayer lobby and one WebSocket relay per online match.

components.name: icelander.net login service
components.responsibility: Who is signed in, and their games: roles.

relationships.description: Starts the engine with the export's configuration.
Online matches: a WebSocket to /games/multiplayer/match/{ID}, opened with ?match=ID from the lobby.
Asks who is signed in before serving the page (games:play).
